caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with a scoop-like shape, primarily colored in shades of brown, gray, and rusty yellow. The main body consists of a semi-cylindrical cavity with an open top and slanted sides, reinforced at the open end by a horizontal metal rod running across the width. Attached to the broader end of the scoop are five cylindrical tubes arranged parallel to one another, all emerging from the flat edge. On the side, perpendicular to the tubes, is a cylindrical handle, which appears to be made of a darker, corroded metal, attached through a circular mounting. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, and there is a signature, “OSCAR BLUHME,” written near the bottom right corner.
title: Candle Mold Filler
